figures.finding: Bolivia taxes only Bolivian-source income; an employee pays RC-IVA at a flat 13% on gross pay after pension contributions and other legal deductions (input VAT on purchases may be credited), with no local income tax. Since Ley 1448 (2022) a self-employed professional or tradesperson (an actor, writer or director working on their own account) is also taxed under RC-IVA at 13%, no longer under IUE; a non-domiciled person's fees for work in Bolivia fall in RC-IVA too, except artists and sportspeople in international contests.

value.base: gross pay less pension contributions and legal deductions

sources.said: Se incorporan los incisos g) y h) en el Artículo 19 de la Ley N° 843 (Texto Ordenado vigente), con el siguiente texto: "g. Los provenientes del ejercicio de la profesión u oficios en forma libre o independiente. h. Los honorarios, retribuciones o ingresos por pagos, cualquiera sea su denominación, de personas no domiciliadas en el Estado Plurinacional de Bolivia, provenientes del trabajo desarrollado en territorio nacional. No están alcanzados por este impuesto los ingresos de deportistas y artistas, no domiciliados, por trabajos en actividades de concurso, competencia o torneos internacionales." … a. La frase "el ejercicio de profesiones liberales y oficios sujetos a reglamentación", del Artículo 39 de la Ley N° 843 (Texto Ordenado Vigente).

The personal income tax ( Regimen Complementario del Impuesto al Valor Agregado or RC-IVA) rate is 13%. Employers have the obligation to withhold and pay to the tax authorities the RC-IVA on gross income after deduction of social contributions and other concepts established by tax law. … There are no local taxes on personal income in Bolivia.

Self-employed professionals also are subject to RC-IVA, while income from other business activities remains subject to IUE. … Rates: The RC-IVA rate generally is 13%. … Deductions and allowances: A credit is allowed for the 13% VAT included in invoices issued to the taxpayer for purchases of goods and services.

figures.finding: The employee pays 12.71% of gross salary to the pension system (to 60 minimum salaries a month), plus a solidarity contribution of 1.15% to 11.48% on pay above BOB 13,000; the employer pays 15.21% of pay (17.21% in mining), including 2% to the National Housing Fund.
figures.applies: Employees. The earlier reading that only the employee contributes (PwC's pension paragraph) is corrected by Deloitte's employer 15.21%; the split of that 15.21% (health, professional risk, solidarity, housing) is not stated (see blocker).

sources.said: Pension funds are administered privately, and only employees contribute toward their retirement pension. The contribution rate is 12.71% calculated on gross salary with a threshold of 60 minimum national salaries per month (i.e. approximately 28,450 United States dollars [USD]). … employees who earn more than 13,000 bolivianos (BOB) per month are subject to a supportive social contribution determined on a scale system from 1.15% up to 11.48% over the gross salary.

The employer must contribute 15.21% (17.21% for mining companies) of the employee’s income, and the employee must contribute 12.71%. … The employer also must contribute 2% to the National Housing Fund.

figures.finding: The employer withholds RC-IVA at 13% from pay monthly and files a consolidated return; an employee files no annual return, while a non-employee subject to RC-IVA files quarterly.

sources.said: The employer submits a consolidated tax return on a monthly basis and withholds the tax (RC-IVA) on employee's income. … Individuals working as employees are not required to submit an annual tax return. … Individuals who are not employees and are subject to RC-IVA need to submit a tax return on a quarterly basis.

figures.finding: A payment to a non-domiciled individual for activities performed in Bolivia bears 16% withholding (3% transaction tax plus 13% RC-IVA).

sources.said: Payments to non-domiciled individuals for their activities performed within Bolivian territory are subject to a WHT at a rate of 16%, such rate refers to transaction tax at rate of 3% and personal income tax ( Regimen Complementario del Impuesto al Valor Agregado or RC-IVA) at a rate of 13%.

figures.finding: Royalties paid to a non-resident bear 12.5% withholding; activities such as the production or distribution of films only partly performed in Bolivia bear a reduced 2.5%.

sources.said: Dividend payments, distributions of profits to the head office by Bolivian branches, interest payments, royalty payments, and fees paid for any type of services made to non-residents are subject to a WHT of 12.5%. … Activities considered partially performed within Bolivian territory (e.g. telecommunication services, insurance, transportation, production/distribution of cinematographic films … by non-residents are subject to a reduced WHT of 2.5%.

figures.finding: Services in Bolivia bear VAT at 13%, and gross income from any activity bears the 3% transaction tax monthly.

sources.said: VAT is levied on the sale of movable goods and provision of services carried out within Bolivian territory at a standard rate of 13%

The tax on gross income (also known as transaction tax) generally taxes gross income arising from the performance of any economic or commercial activity (including non-profitable activities) at a rate of 3% on a monthly basis.

figures.finding: RC-IVA for an independent is assessed by calendar quarter (to 31 March, 30 June, 30 September, 31 December); employment income is settled by monthly withholding with no annual return.

sources.said: Tax period: The tax period is the calendar quarter ending 31 March, 30 June, 30 September, and 31 December of each year. … Filing and payment: Employment income is taxed by withholding.
